turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Of course. I will solve one first and explain.
It is ___ hour. We write "h", but the first sound we say is "ow", a vowel sound. So: It is an hour.
Rule: choose by the first sound: "an" for vowel sounds, "a" for others.
Right: It is a horse. Wrong: It is an horse.
Now you. Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
